_doc: Survivor flags of the canonical jobs (ADR 0006, spec #282). A character is one job, fixed for its life: there is no advancement. `playable` lists the jobs a character can be (in creation order; the first is the default for a fresh character and the tools); every other job is locked with `reason` (else default_reason). start_skills: the skills (survivor keys) a fresh round of this job starts with at rank 1, in casting order: 212 starts with Energy Bolt (until the skill pool lands, #287) and Teleport on its key from Lv1 (#284). creation_weapon is the weapon a new character of the job wears (creation, #286; tier C, the Magician line's own v83 starting wand, 1372005; wearing rules are #292's). format1_weapon is the frozen tier C spec #32 migration weapon of format-1 snapshots, resolved through the job lineage.

212._provenance: tier C: owner, ADR 0006 / spec #282: F/P Arch Mage is the only playable job of the slice. Energy Bolt stands in for the starting skill until #287; Teleport (2101002) is a manual skill on its key from Lv1.
